objects.name: agent_memories
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "agent_memories" (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT REFERENCES requests(id), message_id TEXT REFERENCES "chat_messages"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('research','cross_research')), content TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('candidate','verified','rejected','stale')), verification_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', last_checked_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(owner_id,request_id,content_hash))

objects.name: agent_memories_fts
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE agent_memories_fts USING fts5(content, content='agent_memories', content_rowid='rowid', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2')

objects.name: agent_memories_fts_config
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'agent_memories_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: agent_memories_fts_data
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'agent_memories_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

objects.name: agent_memories_fts_docsize
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'agent_memories_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

objects.name: agent_memories_fts_idx

objects.name: analysis_results
analysis_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE analysis_versions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_runs(id),
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES stage_jobs(id), source_snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, coverage_status TEXT NOT NULL, gaps_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: chat_daily_usage
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE chat_daily_usage (subject TEXT NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL,
      search_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, llm_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      input_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      page_fetches INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(subject,day))

objects.name: chat_messages
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "chat_messages" (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "chat_sessions"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user','assistant')), content TEXT NOT NULL, citations_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', turn_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','complete','failed')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, research_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', UNIQUE(chat_id,turn_id,role))

objects.name: chat_sessions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "chat_sessions" (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT REFERENCES requests(id), title TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('documents','research','combined')), document_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, memory_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', busy_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, active_token TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, auto_research INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(auto_research IN (0,1)), internet_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(internet_enabled IN (0,1)))

objects.name: chat_turn_usage
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE chat_turn_usage (chat_id TEXT NOT NULL, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      search_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, llm_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      input_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      page_fetches INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(chat_id,turn_id))

objects.name: chat_web_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE chat_web_sources (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, chat_id TEXT REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, question TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, retrieved_at TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(chat_id,turn_id,url))

objects.name: chunks
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE chunks (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, char_count INTEGER,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES requests(id), FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES sources(id),
        UNIQUE(source_id, chunk_index)
    )

objects.name: dispatch_outbox
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE dispatch_outbox (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_runs(id),
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES stage_jobs(id), event_type TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, sent_at TEXT)

objects.name: document_chunks
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE document_chunks (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, document_id TEXT NOT NULL, page INTEGER NOT NULL,
      chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(document_id,page) REFERENCES document_pages(document_id,page) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      UNIQUE(document_id,page,chunk_index))

objects.name: document_chunks_fts
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE document_chunks_fts USING fts5(content, content='document_chunks', content_rowid='rowid', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2')

objects.name: document_chunks_fts_config
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'document_chunks_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: document_chunks_fts_data
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'document_chunks_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

objects.name: document_chunks_fts_docsize
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'document_chunks_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

objects.name: document_chunks_fts_idx
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'document_chunks_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: document_ingestion_jobs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE document_ingestion_jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','processing','ready','failed')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lease_until INTEGER, error_code TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: document_pages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE document_pages (document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      page INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(page>0), content TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(document_id,page))

objects.name: documents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL,
      storage_name TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_size>0),
      page_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','processing','ready','failed')),
      error_code TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT)

objects.name: evidence
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        chunk_id TEXT, research_question TEXT, evidence_text TEXT NOT NULL,
        relevance_score REAL, reason TEXT, citation_label TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES requests(id), FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES sources(id),
        FOREIGN KEY (chunk_id) REFERENCES chunks(id)
    )

objects.name: evidence_cache
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence_cache (
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id), question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        input_hash TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(request_id, question_id, input_hash)
    )

objects.name: memory_evidence_links
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "memory_evidence_links" (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "agent_memories"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('document','evidence','source')), reference_id TEXT NOT NULL, document_id TEXT, page INTEGER, source_id TEXT, version_hash TEXT NOT NULL, quote TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: plans
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE plans (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
        question_id TEXT NOT NULL, research_question TEXT NOT NULL,
        search_query TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT
    )

objects.name: report_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE report_versions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_runs(id),
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES stage_jobs(id), analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions(id),
 content TEXT NOT NULL, references_json TEXT NOT NULL, citation_validation_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: reports
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE reports (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, title TEXT,
        language TEXT DEFAULT 'vi', style TEXT, output_length TEXT, content TEXT NOT NULL,
        references_json TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES requests(id)
    )

objects.name: requests
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE requests (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, topic TEXT NOT NULL, goal TEXT NOT NULL,
        scope TEXT, output_length TEXT, status TEXT,
        created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT
    , owner_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'workspace')

objects.name: research_documents
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE research_documents (request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id), document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id), owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(request_id,document_id))

objects.name: research_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE research_runs (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id), input_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued','running','completed','partial','failed','cancelled')),
 current_stage TEXT, current_round INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_successful_stage TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 error_code TEXT, error_message TEXT, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, orchestration TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'backend',
 llm_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, search_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 UNIQUE(request_id,idempotency_key))

objects.name: run_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE run_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_runs(id),
 stage TEXT, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: schema_migrations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: source_chunks_v2
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_chunks_v2 (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_runs(id),
 source_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_versions(id), chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(source_version_id,chunk_index))

objects.name: source_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_versions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_runs(id), query TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT, url TEXT NOT NULL,
 normalized_url TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT, original_content TEXT NOT NULL, display_content_vi TEXT,
 content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, language TEXT, translation_status TEXT, collected_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(run_id,normalized_url))

objects.name: sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sources (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
        query TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT, url TEXT NOT NULL,
        normalized_url TEXT NOT NULL, snippet TEXT, content TEXT, provider TEXT,
        collected_at TEXT NOT NULL, title_vi TEXT, snippet_vi TEXT, content_vi TEXT, source_language TEXT, translation_status TEXT, translation_hash TEXT,
        UNIQUE(request_id, normalized_url)
    )

objects.name: stage_jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE stage_jobs (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_runs(id), stage TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','retry_waiting','failed','cancelled')),
 attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, locked_by TEXT, locked_until TEXT, heartbeat_at TEXT,
 input_json TEXT NOT NULL, output_json TEXT, error_json TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 started_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT, available_at TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 UNIQUE(run_id,idempotency_key))

objects.name: user_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT)

objects.name: users
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user' CHECK(role IN ('user','admin')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','disabled')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: document_chunks_ad
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER document_chunks_ad AFTER DELETE ON document_chunks BEGIN INSERT INTO document_chunks_fts(document_chunks_fts,rowid,content) VALUES('delete',old.rowid,old.content); END

objects.name: document_chunks_ai
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER document_chunks_ai AFTER INSERT ON document_chunks BEGIN INSERT INTO document_chunks_fts(rowid,content) VALUES(new.rowid,new.content); END

objects.name: document_chunks_au
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER document_chunks_au AFTER UPDATE ON document_chunks BEGIN INSERT INTO document_chunks_fts(document_chunks_fts,rowid,content) VALUES('delete',old.rowid,old.content); INSERT INTO document_chunks_fts(rowid,content) VALUES(new.rowid,new.content); END

objects.name: knowledge_chunk_stale
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_chunk_stale AFTER DELETE ON document_chunks BEGIN UPDATE agent_memories SET status='stale',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN (SELECT memory_id FROM memory_evidence_links WHERE kind='document' AND reference_id=old.id); END

objects.name: knowledge_document_stale
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_document_stale AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON documents WHEN new.deleted_at IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE agent_memories SET status='stale',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN (SELECT memory_id FROM memory_evidence_links WHERE document_id=new.id); END

objects.name: knowledge_evidence_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_evidence_delete AFTER DELETE ON evidence BEGIN UPDATE agent_memories SET status='stale',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN (SELECT memory_id FROM memory_evidence_links WHERE kind='evidence' AND reference_id=old.id); END

objects.name: knowledge_evidence_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_evidence_update AFTER UPDATE ON evidence BEGIN UPDATE agent_memories SET status='stale',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN (SELECT memory_id FROM memory_evidence_links WHERE kind='evidence' AND reference_id=old.id); END

objects.name: knowledge_source_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_source_delete AFTER DELETE ON sources BEGIN UPDATE agent_memories SET status='stale',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN (SELECT memory_id FROM memory_evidence_links WHERE source_id=old.id); END

objects.name: knowledge_source_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_source_update AFTER UPDATE ON sources BEGIN UPDATE agent_memories SET status='stale',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN (SELECT memory_id FROM memory_evidence_links WHERE source_id=old.id); END

objects.name: memories_ad
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memories_ad AFTER DELETE ON agent_memories BEGIN INSERT INTO agent_memories_fts(agent_memories_fts,rowid,content) VALUES('delete',old.rowid,old.content); END

objects.name: memories_ai
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memories_ai AFTER INSERT ON agent_memories BEGIN INSERT INTO agent_memories_fts(rowid,content) VALUES(new.rowid,new.content); END

objects.name: memories_au
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memories_au AFTER UPDATE OF content ON agent_memories BEGIN INSERT INTO agent_memories_fts(agent_memories_fts,rowid,content) VALUES('delete',old.rowid,old.content); INSERT INTO agent_memories_fts(rowid,content) VALUES(new.rowid,new.content); END
